settings.heading: Safety & how to take
settings.content:
How to take:

  1. Take one capsule daily with water, ideally with breakfast.
  2. Take it at the same time each day to build the habit.
  3. Use consistently for at least 8–12 weeks.

Safety: Vegan, gluten-free, no added sugar, no artificial colours or preservatives. Store in a cool, dry place. Food supplements should not replace a varied diet. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant, nursing, immunocompromised or taking medication.

settings.heading: Common questions
settings.content:
Q: Will I feel any changes in the first week?
A: Some women notice mild changes in digestion in the first few days as the gut adjusts. This is normal and usually settles quickly.

Q: Can I take it with HRT or other supplements?
A: Probiotics are generally well tolerated alongside HRT and multivitamins, but always check with your doctor first.

Q: Do the capsules need refrigeration?
A: No. Our strains are shelf-stable. Just keep them in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
